developer: Bangladesh Agriculture Research Institute (BARI), Gazipur, Bangladesh
planting_time: Rabi: Mid November to mid December
yield_t_ha: Yield in rabi season 10-10.5  t/ha and kharif season 7-7.5 t/ha
main_characteristics: It is single cross hybrid.Average plant height in rabi season 195-200 cm and kharif season 110-115 cm, height of ear 100-110 cm, weight ear 250 g., seed weight / ear 230 g., ear tightly covered with husk, seed/ ear 420, in rabi season silk formation time 90-95 days, grain orange color, grain weight 290-310 g., crop duration  140-145 days and 95-105 days in karif season, A profuse no  anthocyanin colour here in first leaf sheath.
source_org: BARI, via BSMRAU Digital Herbarium of Crop Plants
